title: refactor(Development/AutomorphicArithmetic/OrbitLabellings): reuse InertPrimeDepthContentBoundProof in RowBoundLeFnumSumAddError
body:
Reuse the already-public `GlobalTheory.GoodDepth.Plan`, `GlobalTheory.LevelsOrbits.thlEq`, `GlobalTheory.PlanValue.{rk_le, card_reps}`, and `GlobalTheory.InertContent.{orbit, mono_resι_var, sum_reps, inv_le}` from `InertPrimeDepthContentBoundProof.lean` inside `RowBoundLeFnumSumAddError.lean`, removing the duplicated private plan, flow, and orbit-bound machinery.

Removed private declarations in `UpperTheory.G2.RowPlan`:
- `least_level_odd`, `card_reps`, `rk_le`

Removed private declarations in `UpperTheory.G2.RowBd`:
- `Plan`, `Plan.bound`
- `levels_nonempty`, `thlEq`, `levelBound`
- `exists_good`, `succ_mul_flowVal_le`, `rho_mul_le_Fnum`, `Fnum_mul`, `blockBd_le`, `exists_plan`
- `sum_reps`, `one_le_log`, `logb_le`, `mono_resι_var`, `add_le`, `inv_le`, `orbit`
